question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **important**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Important" **refers to something that is of great consequence or value, and is crucial or necessary. (महत्वपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **Her role in the project was very important, and it couldn't have succeeded without her.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that for a lot of us, developing certain critical abilities is necessary to communicate more effectively and concisely. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3 is **'important'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Boring **(उबाऊ): Not interesting; tedious.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so boring that many students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **Trivial **(तुच्छ): Of little value or importance.
 
 
• **Example: **He often loses focus on the important tasks by getting distracted by trivial details.
 
 
 
• **Wasteful** (फिजूल): Using or expending something of value carelessly or to no purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** It is wasteful to leave the lights on when no one is in the room.
